definition: The study and practice of ensuring machine learning systems do not produce discriminatory or systematically unequal outcomes across different groups.
details: Fairness in ML is a multifaceted and sometimes contested concept, with multiple mathematical definitions (e.g., demographic parity, equalized odds) that can be in tension with each other.
story: Imagine a new medicine that works brilliantly in the lab but still has to be tested on real people before anyone takes it. In plain words: The study and practice of ensuring machine learning systems do not produce discriminatory or systematically unequal outcomes across different groups. Here is how it actually plays out: Fairness in ML is a multifaceted and sometimes contested concept, with multiple mathematical definitions (e.g., demographic parity, equalized odds) that can be in tension with each other. Rules and red-teaming are the brakes that make the speed trustworthy. That deliberate caution is Fairness (in ML).
